camera_link.disabled_reason: rocobrick.isaac_scene._disable_camera_collisions switches this collider off when the scene is built; the vendor USD stays byte-identical.  The hull data is kept so the historical offset12 regression can still be reproduced with SimCollisionHulls(include_disabled=True).

camera_stand_link.disabled_reason: rocobrick.isaac_scene._disable_camera_collisions switches this collider off when the scene is built; the vendor USD stays byte-identical.  The hull data is kept so the historical offset12 regression can still be reproduced with SimCollisionHulls(include_disabled=True).

plane_convention: inside: n.x + d >= 0 (vertices quantized to 1 um)
quantization_note: vertices are stored in whole micrometres, so a stored plane may sit up to 1 um inside its own quantized vertices

robot.evidence: USD collision Xforms carry UsdPhysics.MeshCollisionAPI approximation=convexHull with collision enabled; the USD collision meshes are geometry-identical to the runtime URDF meshes (triangle count and total area matched per link); the d435 body collides as the authored box.
